resources.name: Pure metal properties and Gajjar pseudopotential parameters

access.notes: Elemental data (Z, Ω0, kF, M) are from standard solid‑state physics tabulations (Cohen & Heine, Solid State Physics Vol. 24). The empty‑core radius rC values for Li, Na, K, Rb, Cs are given in the paper. No file download required; the agent must look up or hard‑code these constants.
